Select: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Source: molecule_dictionary, molecule_hierarchy, compound_records, compound_structures, activities, docs, assays, target_dictionary. Join: molecule_dictionary to molecule_hierarchy on molregno to include parent and salts; molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno; compound_records to activities on record_id; compound_records to docs on doc_id; activities to assays on assay_id; activities to target_dictionary on tid; molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter: molecule_dictionary.chembl_id is CHEMBL376359 or parent_molregno corresponds to CHEMBL376359; target_dictionary.chembl_id is CHEMBL284; activities.standard_type is IC50; activities.standard_units is nM. Sort: compound_chembl_id, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
